title: Covariates, outcomes and staged estimation
text: course_engagement one row per course enrolment: 1,422 enrolments 106 students. student identifies group, five activity measures (browse, lectures, forum_read, forum_post, attendance) indicators. previous_grade standardized grade course enrolment; indicator, can serve external variable.
code: library(latents)

title: Covariates, outcomes and staged estimation
text: fit profiles without external variable, call multilpa() vars indicators, id group, n_profiles, n_group_classes, n_starts seed.
code: fit <- multilpa(course_engagement,                 vars = c("browse", "lectures", "forum_read", "forum_post",                          "attendance"),                 id = "student", n_profiles = 2, n_group_classes = 2,                 n_starts = 10, seed = 1) fit #> Two-level latent profile analysis: 2 profiles, 2 group classes #> 1422 individuals in 106 groups; varying diagonal residual covariance (VVI) #> Log likelihood: -8439.816434 | AIC: 16925.633 | BIC (groups): 16986.892 #> Converged: TRUE | iterations: 8 | best start: 8/10 #>  #>  profile browse lectures forum_read forum_post attendance count proportion #>        1 -0.766   -0.606     -0.879     -0.753     -0.921   588      0.413 #>        2  0.540    0.427      0.620      0.531      0.649   834      0.587 #>  #> Variances and standard errors: get_results(x, "profiles").  #> Every other table: get_results(x, what = ), or get_results(x, "all").

title: Covariates, outcomes and staged estimation
text: obtain classification-error matrix, call get_results() "classification_errors" level observations groups. row gives probability assigned class cases true class; three-step methods use correct misclassification.
code: get_results(fit, "classification_errors", level = "individuals") #>         level true_class assigned_class probability #> 1 individuals          1              1      0.9786 #> 2 individuals          1              2      0.0214 #> 3 individuals          2              1      0.0128 #> 4 individuals          2              2      0.9872

what: Class means of an external variable
title: Covariates, outcomes and staged estimation
text: estimate mean external variable profile, call three_step() data data frame outcome variable. default method, BCH, corrects classification error; standard errors clustered groups. compare profiles, call three_step() contrast = "pairs", returns difference profile means Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted p-value. see effect ignoring classification error, call three_step() method = "modal", treats case’s probable profile known.
code: three_step(fit, data = course_engagement, outcome = "previous_grade") #>         level method class estimate standard_error conf_low conf_high effective_n #> 1 individuals    bch     1   -0.315         0.0359   -0.385    -0.244         564 #> 2 individuals    bch     2    0.222         0.0347    0.154     0.290         810 three_step(fit, data = course_engagement, outcome = "previous_grade",            contrast = "pairs") #>         level method class reference_class estimate standard_error statistic  p_value #> 1 individuals    bch     2               1    0.536          0.052      10.3 5.72e-25 #>   p_value_adjusted conf_low conf_high #> 1         5.72e-25    0.435     0.638 three_step(fit, data = course_engagement, outcome = "previous_grade",            method = "modal") #>         level method class estimate standard_error conf_low conf_high effective_n #> 1 individuals  modal     1   -0.305         0.0357   -0.375    -0.235         586 #> 2 individuals  modal     2    0.214         0.0343    0.146     0.281         836

title: Covariates, outcomes and staged estimation
text: regress profile membership covariate, call r3step() data data frame covariates predictors. returns multinomial logit coefficients, corrected classification error. vcov_type = "robust" clusters standard errors groups.
code: r3step(fit, data = course_engagement, covariates = "previous_grade",        vcov_type = "robust") #>         level outcome           term estimate standard_error statistic  p_value p_value_adjusted #> 1 individuals class_1    (Intercept)   -0.376         0.1303     -2.89 3.91e-03               NA #> 2 individuals class_1 previous_grade   -0.575         0.0593     -9.69 3.35e-22         3.35e-22 #>   conf_low conf_high #> 1   -0.631    -0.121 #> 2   -0.691    -0.459

title: Covariates, outcomes and staged estimation
text: Three-step methods assume classification errors independent external variable given true class, treat error matrix known. One-step coefficients conditional group class can change profiles, need equal three-step coefficients. Staged estimation carry first-stage uncertainty second stage, likelihood joint maximum. associations observational.
